reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as active-learning MLIPs have been shown to capture anharmonicity and free-energy surfaces in elemental and binary systems, but the claim that they inherently retain electron-vibration coupling without explicit electronic structure is a notable gap.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, with specific benchmarks and a falsification criterion, but it lacks practical details on how the MLIP will be validated for electron-vibration coupling and how cost reduction will be measured.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the cost bottleneck for high-entropy alloys and proposes a well-defined, high-impact methodological advance that many researchers would want to see tested.
